reviews.text: I haven't had the pleasure of buying from them, not because I don't want to, but because they don't answer messages. I've bought from the branch across from the Emilio Carranza market, but the customer service is terrible. Could you give me a number where they actually provide good service? 1/1
Good prices, and a great variety and quality of pet food and products in general, great service!
A great place for specialty products and they also gave me advice on feeding my puppy.

I loved shopping at Pet's Home 🐾. It's a super complete pet store; you can really find everything: food, accessories, toys, and excellent quality products.

What I liked most is that they have great prices without sacrificing quality. Plus, the service is friendly, and they always help you choose the best for your pets.
It has definitely become my go-to store. I highly recommend it!

I really appreciate the service and attention they provide. The young woman is super nice, attentive, and warm. She's clearly an expert on pet-related topics and always gives excellent answers and solutions. She resolves my doubts and always manages to recommend the best products for my pets. She even gives a questionnaire to help her recommend the best products based on my pets' needs. Excellent place and highly recommended!

I visited the store on Saturday, February 21st, before noon. I was looking for a chain for my dog, but the girl who helped me knew everything except good customer service. She spoke abruptly, was rude, and questioned absolutely everything. I had to bring my dog's trainer and my dog ​​along for her to stop questioning me about the technical specifications of a chain, and even then, she didn't give us what we needed. We had to choose it ourselves. I had gone there a few years ago looking for the same thing, and the experience was exactly the same; that's why I hadn't returned. I hope that girl isn't the owner because the store is very good; it has many options, food, pet products, and from what I read in reviews, other employees are very good. It's a shame about the terrible experience, the awful service, and the person with the terrible attitude. Please don't reply that I should have gone to another branch, since I go to the one closest to me.
I've been buying food for my dogs from them for several years now, and the service has always been excellent.

The girl who helped me was really grumpy. She was in line behind someone else and only let her in. She just asked me what I needed. At least she could have let me see the items I required. They should make it clear that appointments are required to enter. Anyway, I won't be going back to that place.

I love this place; they have an incredible selection, the store is spotless, and the products are so unique and high-quality.
The staff is wonderful; they treat me and my puppy incredibly well, answer all my questions and concerns without hesitation, and the advice they've given me is amazing.

The personalized attention is top-notch, and if you have any questions about your pet's care, they'll advise you expertly and clearly.
There are many options to choose from and a variety of prices.
They are aquarium experts.
